Reads the external heap state through owner+48; for non-direct mode rejects an active0x2000 guard, sets0x4000 and validates the payload through80214718, then sets0x2000. Marks the block header atpayload-4 with bit4 and fills the original marked-size-minus8 payload extent with0xdd. Links small blocks below64 into the original size-indexed free bucket; otherwise installs the first pending block atstate+16 or chains throughstate+84. Calls original optional callback8040077c only for non-direct mode and exact masked flags0x42, passing the original payload extent with low3 flags removed. Clears0x2000 and returns zero; null returns zero and validation failures return minus1. All heap and block types remain external views accessed by typed pointer accessors; no aggregate is constructed locally, no initialized data is owned, and no allocator behavior or safety checks are invented. Names and deferred-release semantics are inferred.
